usedFor: Shopify holds checkouts, and Ploomes updates the shopper through “Update contact” after an “Abandoned Checkout”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Update contact” in Ploomes
bestTemplate.why: The shopper's contact gets new details and custom fields, so sales see the abandoned cart.

watchOut: “Update contact” needs the Ploomes contact ID, so look it up before “Abandoned Checkout” reaches it.
